house.description: Commissioner of administration funding provided to facilitate cultural exchanges involving diverse Minnesota communities, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to facilitate cultural exchanges involving diverse Minnesota communities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CULTURAL EXCHANGES INVOLVING DIVERSE MINNESOTA COMMUNITIES. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of St. Paul to plan and host cultural exchange events celebrating the relationship between diverse communities in the host city and its sister cities in Southeast Asia. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to facilitate cultural exchanges involving diverse Minnesota communities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CULTURAL EXCHANGES INVOLVING DIVERSE MINNESOTA COMMUNITIES.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of St. Paul to plan and host cultural exchange events celebrating the relationship between diverse communities in the host city and its sister cities in Southeast Asia.
additions: APPROPRIATION; CULTURAL EXCHANGES INVOLVING DIVERSE MINNESOTA COMMUNITIES.
